context:

Problem (rule): D33's ruling sentence, "The four pipeline commands are reachable from a screen", was written for the four-command pipeline. After #1043 it opens with pricing on #/pricing and with the decisions.json refusal, so it is unclear whether it still governs anything. Whether every step is still reachable is unmeasured.
Based on (read): lane prose-cuts-banchi, banchi #1043 (review round 3 PASS).
Based on (read): the outcome D33 protected: no step that spends money or changes data is reachable only from a shell.
Departs from: banchi D33 on main — a rewrites it to today's screens; b retires it.
home: banchi D33 (every pipeline step is reachable from a screen)

options.gain: The "no shell-only step" outcome keeps a live record, with a measured list.

options.gain: One less record to keep true.

title: banchi D33 says every pipeline step is reachable from a screen, but its opening now speaks of today's pricing screen. Rewrite it to today's screens, or retire it?
